reason: B proposes the more substantive and novel intervention, with a physically plausible entropy-engineered oxide support, explicit light-off and durability metrics, and a falsifiable aging experiment; A largely restates the well-established ceria–alumina oxygen-storage strategy and inconsistently compares equal PGM loadings while claiming reduced consumption.
